title: New Space meters for Circles, upcoming Events, guests per Event, published Practices, bookable services and shop listings
detail:
PHASE 2 of the five-tier ladder (ADR-1709). TARGET: merged before 2026-11-24, because pricing_settings.beta_grace ends 2026-12-01 and every count limit enforces that day with no deploy. New keys space_circles (3/10/unlimited, the Space Circle counts), space_events (5 upcoming), space_event_guests (100) and personal event_guests (Member 30, Crew 100), space_practice_publish (5), space_services (1), space_shop_listings (5, inquiries only), each with a count at its write path.

Seven new meters (space_circles, space_events, space_event_guests, event_guests, space_practice_publish, space_services, space_shop_listings) with counts at their write paths in lib/spaces/counted-meters.ts. Guest RSVP through the capture_guest_rsvp SQL function and paid ticket settlement are not counted yet; a full guest meter puts a new member yes on the waitlist.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(f)=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const lim=(()=>{const s=r("lib/pricing/meter-limits.ts");const a=s.indexOf("PLACEHOLDER_METER_LIMITS");const b=s.indexOf("= {",a);const e=s.indexOf("\n}\n",b);return Function("return "+s.slice(b+2,e+2).replace(/\/\/.*$/gm,"").replace(/(\d)_(\d)/g,"$1$2"))()})();const want=(k,t,v)=>{const row=lim[k];if(!row)fail(k+" is not a meter yet");if(!(t in row)||row[t]!==v)fail(k+"."+t+" is "+JSON.stringify(row[t])+", the ladder says "+JSON.stringify(v))};const walk=(d,o=[])=>{if(!fs.existsSync(d))return o;for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=d+"/"+f.name;if(f.isDirectory()){if(f.name!=="node_modules")walk(p,o)}else if(/\.tsx?$/.test(f.name)&&!/\.test\./.test(f.name))o.push(p)}return o};const src=[...walk("lib"),...walk("app")].filter((f)=>!f.startsWith("lib/pricing/")).map((f)=>[f,r(f)]);const usedAt=(k,seam)=>src.some(([f,s])=>s.includes(JSON.stringify(k).replace(/"/g,String.fromCharCode(39)))&&seam.test(s));want("space_circles","free",3);want("space_circles","business",10);want("space_circles","collective",null);want("space_events","free",5);want("space_event_guests","free",100);want("event_guests","free",30);want("event_guests","crew",100);want("space_practice_publish","free",5);want("space_services","free",1);want("space_shop_listings","free",5);const seam=/spaceAllowance(Verdict|Headroom)\(|memberWithinLeadershipAllowance\(/;const miss=["space_circles","space_events","space_event_guests","event_guests","space_practice_publish","space_services","space_shop_listings"].filter((k)=>!usedAt(k,seam));if(miss.length)fail("no write path asks: "+miss.join(","));console.log("ok: the new Space meters exist and are asked at write")'
